expectFailure: Must fail pleading QA on every one of the following, each of which is prohibited invention or a prohibited assertion for this track: (1) it populates court name, county, case/docket number, OTN, judge, county attorney name and filing date that no source supplies, and names a decriminalized marijuana conviction expungement judge when whether any such judge has been appointed under § 16-12-115 is unresolved; (2) it asserts the county attorney's position and completed service, which are outside-party acts; (3) it asserts a court outcome — “Resentenced and expunged”, courtOutcome “granted” — and combines two mutually exclusive outcomes; (4) it recommends the outcome election, which the registry reserves to the participant alone; (5) it computes a resentencing result, which § 16-12-113(3)-(4) constrain and which the registry states is not present in the packet at all; (6) it asserts that no hearing will be held under § 16-12-113(7), when whether that default reaches a subsection (1) petition is unresolved; (7) it consolidates three convictions into one form set, when a separate complete set is required for each conviction; (8) it states a filing fee amount when no source states one, and reproduces the Montana Legal Services Association fee-waiver form, which carries a non-commercial-use restriction and may only be linked to; and (9) it fills protected fields — date of birth, SSN, state ID and FBI number — that must stay blank, while suppressing the custody handoff that “in custody” must trigger.
